source.name: Volkswagen maintenance schedule reissue
source.note: Read from Volkswagen's USA maintenance schedules for 2022, as reissued in 12/2025, in Glovebox's wording. Check it against the booklet that came with your car.
source.basis: The mileages and jobs of the battery-electric schedule in Volkswagen's own USA maintenance schedules, as Volkswagen reissued them on its owners' literature site, for a car the owner maintains. Only those facts are taken; jobs are named in Glovebox's words and no text or layout is copied.
